# [CS058] Local Replace Directive in go.mod (gomod-local-replace)

A replace directive points at a local directory.

| | |
| --- | --- |
| **Severity** | MEDIUM |
| **Category** | Supply Chain & Provenance |
| **CWE** | [CWE-1357](https://cwe.mitre.org/data/definitions/1357.html) |
| **OWASP** | A03:2025 |
| **Auto-Fix supported** | No |

## Why It Matters in Go

A directory replacement exists only on the machine that wrote it; on CI or another developer's machine the build fails or uses different code. Use a go.work file for local development, or replace with a published version.

## Vulnerable / Problematic Example

```text
replace example.com/shared => ../shared
```

## Safe / Idiomatic Go Pattern

```text
replace example.com/shared => example.com/shared v1.4.2
```

## Configuration & Suppression

Disable the rule for the whole module in `.codexsentinel.yaml`:

```yaml
rules:
  disabled: [gomod-local-replace]
```

Change its severity:

```yaml
rules:
  severity_overrides:
    gomod-local-replace: low
```

Suppress one reviewed finding on its line, with the reason:

```go
//codex:ignore gomod-local-replace -- <reason>
```

Or ignore it under a path in `.codexsentinel.ignore`:

```text
internal/legacy/** gomod-local-replace
```
